title: Everyone is paid from one tank
intro: Every city's people are paid from one shared fund, Payroll. Each hour it pours out a budget and splits it by what each seat asked for. A quiet hour means more for everyone, a busy one less.
note: Early on the tank pours extra: up to ×8 for the first 7 city days, then up to ×3. Only while it holds enough.
alt: A water tower labelled Payroll feeds three islands; in a quiet hour three cups overflow, in a busy hour nine cups are equally half full.
